At approx. 10:45 today, during final mooring of MV Blue Horizon at Berth C2, a stern spring line parted. No injuries reported. The Master was informed immediately. The vessel's agent (TransOcean Shipping) has been notified. A replacement line of the same spec has been sourced from the port store and will be delivered to the berth by 13:00. The vessel remains secured with remaining lines; an additional head line has been put out as a precaution.

SUBJECT: Mooring line parting – MV Blue Horizon, Berth C2

At approx. 10:45 today, during final mooring of MV Blue Horizon at Berth C2, a stern spring line parted. No injuries reported. The line was a 40mm polypropylene, recently inspected (Feb 2026) with no noted defects. Vessel had just completed berthing with Tug 3 assist. The line parted during heaving-in of the stern breast line, not during the actual berthing manoeuvre.

The Master was informed immediately. The vessel's agent (TransOcean Shipping) has been notified. A replacement line of the same spec has been sourced from the port store and will be delivered to the berth by 13:00. The vessel remains secured with remaining lines; an additional head line has been put out as a precaution.
